scope: static code audit + deterministic reservation arithmetic + unchanged-green admission/rollback suites; no runtime change

reservation_semantics.max_pages_per_request: factory session scratch.max_positions rounded to 256-token pages = the full configured context
reservation_semantics.page_bytes_note: uniform INT8 KV, 256 tokens/block, this geometry (16 layers x 2 x 4 kv-heads x 256 dim x 1B)
guarantees: Admission accounting always sees the pinned workspace pages: no request can be admitted against them, so no admitted request can lack rollback capacity
_GGUFPackedTargetState.allocate can always draw lease_pages[:total_pages] without mid-request allocation failure (the workspace never grows beyond the lease by construction)
Union geometry is genuine-growth-only (never shrinks); growth invalidates live packed decode graphs and flushes deferred state before reallocating, so no graph binds freed buffers
An over-need allocation fails closed with 'packed workspace lease holds X pages but the workspace needs Y'

consumers.path: packed AR prefill (the serving prefill slab, incl. c1 direct-int8 slot-local route)
consumers.context_bound: requests slot_capacity = max(1024, max_live_count) unconditionally; rejects >= 1024 only for non-slot-local scattered layouts
consumers.note: the layout is rebound to workspace pages (_rebind_packed_verify_layout_pages); the workspace planes back the packed slab at full context on the serving route

consumers.context_bound: slot capacity from live positions with a 1024 floor; MTP is not enabled for this model family in the default policy

reservation_semantics.audit_conclusion: The full-context lease is honest for the dense serving route: the packed AR prefill path draws workspace pages at full request context unconditionally, including the c1 direct-int8 slot-local route. The C1/256K figure (8 GiB workspace on top of 8 GiB request KV) is the real cost of the packed slab backing, not accounting waste. A naive bound to the 1024-token floor would break long-context serving prefill.

reservation_by_context.note: deterministic arithmetic from the lease formula and page size; C = serving capacity (workspace_slots); request KV shown for comparison
reservation_by_context.bounded_floor_if_applicable: 4 pages/slot = 32 MiB (the 1024-token union floor); at C1/256K the hypothetical saving would be 1,020 pages = 7.97 GiB, but only if the serving prefill path's workspace usage is proven scratch-only

bound_proposal.proposal: Bound the lease to the 1024-token floor only for engines with no speculative serving configured AND only after an instrumented GPU experiment proves the c1 direct-int8 slot-local prefill's workspace planes are scratch-only (KV written through the scheduler page table). Alternative that needs no proof: route long-context slot-local prefill to per-session paths under capacity pressure.
bound_proposal.blocker: The packed AR prefill binds its layout to workspace pages at full context by construction; determining whether the c1 route actually reads/writes those planes (versus writing through scheduler pages) requires a page-usage trace experiment that was not run (GPU1 occupied by an external benchmark during this audit).

dms_note: The DMS route measured by the capacity campaign does not use this server pool (private-C1 session construction); the 232,448-token capacity result is unaffected by this reservation.
